rows.coder_note: Reference 20 (Sun 2023) has four dictionary rows; the attributes given (Olink, 54,219 participants, 2923 proteins) match the sample size of none of them and no ancestry or subcohort is stated.

rows.quote: The deCODE health study similarly utilized the high-throughput SomaScan platform to quantify 4907 aptamers associated with plasma protein levels in a cohort of 35,559 Icelandic individuals [21].
rows.reference_quote: Ferkingstad E., Sulem P., Atlason B.A., Sveinbjornsson G., Magnusson M.I., Styrmisdottir E.L., Gunnarsdottir K., Helgason A., Oddsson A., Halldorsson B.V., et al. Large-Scale Integration of the Plasma Proteome with Genetics and Disease. Nat. Genet. 2021;53:1712–1721. doi: 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w.
rows.coder_note: The deCODE data (SomaScan, 4907 aptamers, 35,559 Icelanders) are attributed to reference 21, whose DOI 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w is that of the Ferkingstad 2021 row alone.
